text.p: These were the main news headlines reported by Radio Latvia at noon on Wednesday.
Reuters has not verified these reports and cannot vouch for their accuracy.
- Latvia and Russia in Moscow today will co-ordinate the timing of the meetings of the inter-governmental commission, planned to take place twice a year.

- Russia does not intend to prolong its lease of the Skrunda radar station, the country's ambassador Alexander Udalcov said. The Latvian press earlier reported delays in the construction of a substitute radar facility in Belarus.
- The defence ministry has illegaly spent 40,000 lats and paid 275,000 lats in excess of market prices for renovation work at the Adazhi base, headquarters for Baltbat.
- The first joint-excercises of engineering units of the armed forces of the Baltic states take place in Adazhi today.
